weather.summary: Mostly Sunny then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
weather.blurb: Another Heat Advisory — but there is a real shot at rain this afternoon.

air.blurb: Clear air. A great day to be outside.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.blurb: A little grasses and ragweed around — most noses won't notice.

grid.blurb: The grid leans on the afternoon again; ERCOT expects enough to go around.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 12 hours and 54 minutes today, and down by 7:59 p.m.
